messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "you may report side effects to FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088"
set: ["you may report side effects to FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088", "call your doctor at once if you have side effects", "take with meals to reduce side effects", "use slow-release tablets to reduce gastric side effects", "report symptoms at injection site", "tell your doctor if side effects bother you a lot", "this raises the risk of side effects", "treatment options are available for side effects", "discuss sexual side effects with your doctor", "dose will be increased slowly to minimise gastrointestinal side effects", "report weight changes to doctor", "report weight gain to doctor", "report anxiety to your doctor", "stop using and call your doctor at once if serious side effects occur", "using more than the recommended dose may increase the chance of corticosteroid-related side effects", "call your doctor at once if you have a serious side effect"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
